Container.Name: pm
Container.Overview: pm — Plex Metadata Agent. Scans your media library, fetches metadata from external APIs or HTML sites via drop-in plugins, writes Kodi-compatible NFO sidecar files, downloads posters and fanart, and pushes everything to Plex with field locks so the built-in agent won't overwrite your custom metadata. A built-in web dashboard lets you view run history, browse loaded plugins, and trigger manual runs.
Container.Description: pm — Plex Metadata Agent. Fetches metadata for your media files from external APIs and HTML sites via drop-in Python plugins, writes NFO sidecars + artwork, and syncs to Plex with field locks.

Config.Name: Plugins directory
Config.Description: Drop .py plugin files here. Changes take effect on container restart.

Config.Name: Config directory
Config.Description: Stores run reports and log files.

Config.Name: Media directory
Config.Description: Root of your media library. NFO sidecars and artwork are written here.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the pm web dashboard. Access via http://[Unraid-IP]:[PORT]/

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: URL of your Plex Media Server on your local network.

Config.Name: Plex Token
Config.Description: Your Plex authentication token. Find it in Plex Web: Settings → Troubleshooting → Get Online Media Info token, or via plex.tv/claim.

Config.Name: Library paths
Config.Description: Comma-separated paths inside the container to scan for media files. E.g. /media/Movies,/media/TV

Config.Name: Run schedule (cron)
Config.Description: When to run the metadata agent. Default: 3am every day. Cron format: minute hour day month weekday.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

Config.Name: Log retention days
Config.Description: Delete log files older than N days.

Config.Name: Report retention days
Config.Description: Delete run report files older than N days.

Config.Name: Web UI enabled
Config.Description: Set to false to disable the web dashboard.

Config.Name: Web UI port (env)
Config.Description: Must match the port mapping above.

Config.Name: Plugin directory (container)
Config.Description: Container path where plugin .py files are discovered.

Config.Name: Report path (container)
Config.Description: Container path where run reports are written.

Config.Name: Log path (container)
Config.Description: Container path where rotating log files are written.
